signal: Expansion de l'empreinte nationale de soins primaires seniors par M&A
story_fr: L'acquisition recemment finalisee de MaxHealth ajoute environ 59 000 patients et 54 centres a CenterWell Senior Primary Care, contribuant a une croissance sequentielle de 110 500 patients (plus de 22 pourcent) sur le trimestre.
story_en: The recently completed acquisition of MaxHealth adds approximately 59,000 patients and 54 centers to CenterWell Senior Primary Care, contributing to sequential growth of 110,500 patients (over 22 percent) in the quarter.

short: Partenariat CenterWell Pharmacy x Cost Plus
story_fr: CenterWell Pharmacy s'associe a Cost Plus pour developper de nouvelles solutions integrees de medicaments sur ordonnance destinees aux employeurs.
story_en: CenterWell Pharmacy and Cost Plus are partnering to develop new, end-to-end employer prescription drug solutions.

short: Lancement contrats Medicaid Michigan, Illinois, Caroline du Sud
story_fr: La croissance d'environ 50 000 adherents des contrats d'Etat au 1er trimestre 2026 est portee par le demarrage de programmes Medicaid dans le Michigan, l'Illinois et la Caroline du Sud.
story_en: 1Q26 state-based contracts membership growth of approximately 50,000 is driven by the start of programs in Michigan, Illinois, and South Carolina.
